name: @lucid/adapter-openai-agents
description: @lucid/adapter-openai-agents — the THIRD community adapter, authored ENTIRELY through the PUBLIC @lucid/adapter-sdk surface (defineAdapter + emit-or-omit) + @lucid/hsc-schema, with NO core-internal access. Models the OpenAI Agents SDK lifecycle onto HSC events; the Agents SDK has no verification/feedback hook, so it emits NO verify.result / feedback.check — that absence is an honest signal declared in honestAbsences, never synthesized. It is the EC-1 proof that a third party can author + certify an adapter unaided.
